en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Tumayli, from Al Husayn Bin Ahmad Al Halby, from his father, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa has been made to be to humble the tyrants’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Taymuliy from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Halabiy from his father from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Sa‘y (walking) between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah is made to humble the tyrants.”
